liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bluegrass Breakdown (2)** (2 other sources): Opens with a brief teaser of This Heart of Mine [1][2]
- **Train, Train (3)** (2 other sources): Opens with a brief teaser of While I'm Waiting Here [1][2]

## Setlist highlights

- **If I Lose**: rare: 10 archived performances [6]
- **Bluegrass Breakdown (2)**: back after 104 archived shows (489 days) [6]
- **Dark Hallow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Ashland Breakdown**: rare: 10 archived performances [6]
- **S2: Portrait of the Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Rabbit in a Log (BS/JW) (5)**: rare: 4 archived performances [6]
- **If Your Hair’s Too Long (5)**: rare: 14 archived performances [6]
- **Close By**: rare: 6 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2023-02-17.Flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 30 songs; 144 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **billystrings2023-02-17.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: source not stated; 30 songs; 143 min [2]
- **billystrings2023-02-17.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: source not stated; 30 songs; 143 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer first held tickets only for this night, then got Saturday tickets once more were released and attended both [5]
- Reviewer says the first set includes eight cover songs [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2023-02-17.Flac24**: taped by Van Lefford; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: IPhone 13 Pro Music Recorder [1]
- **billystrings2023-02-17.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: taped by Keith Litzeberger; transferred by Keith Litzeberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>KCY 250/5i>Baby Nbox>Sony PCM-A10 [2]. Also: Schoeps MK41v mics into a Sony PCM-A10 at 24-bit/48k, recorded front of board, then converted to 16-bit FLAC [2]
- **billystrings2023-02-17.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>KCY>Baby Nbox>A10 [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings Hard Rock Hotel & Casino - Atlantic City, NJ - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/show/hard-rock-hotel-casino-atlantic-city-nj-2/) [7]
- Fan art by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings Hard Rock Hotel & Casino - Atlantic City, NJ - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/show/hard-rock-hotel-casino-atlantic-city-nj-2/) [8]
- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings Hard Rock Hotel & Casino - Atlantic City, NJ - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/show/hard-rock-hotel-casino-atlantic-city-nj-2/) [9]
